faq.q: Is my screenshot uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. All processing happens entirely in your browser using the Canvas API. Your screenshots never leave your device. There is no server that receives or stores your files.

The output resolution depends on your input screenshot and the padding settings. The tool generates a high-resolution image at 1x pixel density. For retina-quality output, upload a high-resolution screenshot.

faq.q: Can I customize the gradient colors?
faq.a: Yes! We offer 10 curated gradient presets, and you can also use the custom background color picker to set any solid color. For full gradient customization, pick a preset that's close to what you want and adjust.

faq.q: What is the browser frame style?
faq.a: The Browser frame adds a macOS-style window title bar above your screenshot, complete with red, yellow, and green traffic light buttons and a thin address bar. It makes web screenshots instantly recognizable as websites.

faq.q: Can I use this for commercial projects?
faq.a: Absolutely. The output images are yours to use for any purpose — personal or commercial. There are no watermarks, no attribution requirements, and no usage restrictions.

faq.q: What image formats are supported for input?
faq.a: We support JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and BMP for input. The tool works best with PNG screenshots for maximum quality, but any standard image format will work.

faq.q: How do I get the best-looking result?
faq.a: Use a high-resolution screenshot (at least 1280px wide), add generous padding (64-100px), choose a gradient that complements your screenshot's color scheme, and add a subtle shadow (30-50px blur, 20-30% opacity). These settings create a professional, polished look.
